articleTitle: Application of Blockchain Technology in the Cultural and Creative Industries
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Nowadays blockchain technology is a subject of continuous interest both of scientists and practitioners in order to expand its implementation in other sectors of economy and finance. Still the most popular application of blockchain technology rests bitcoins. The present paper proposes several possible applications of blockchain in the sphere of Cultural and Creative Industries based on the proven and accepted so far strengths of the technology.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Study on Waste Heat Thermoelectric Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The increasing pressure to develop alternative methods for clean energy, as well as the growing release of so-called waste heat from industrial plants and other anthropogenic activities, which according to studies varies between 20 + 50%, has focused efforts on improving a somewhat forgotten technology - thermoelectricity. Thermoelectric modules generate E.M.F. when between their two working surfaces there is a temperature difference. The goal of the article is to answer the question of the appropriateness of using these elements in harvesting devices to obtain electrical energy from low temperature (below 100°C) heat sources.

articleTitle: An Experiment on the Joint use of the Heuristic and Project Methods at the University
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: An experiment was conducted to check the relationship between the results of the project team work and the selection of team members that takes into account personality types of students. In the first kind of project team there were participants without special advance preparation. The second and third kinds of project teams were going through special trainings in creativity enhancement method. In addition, a third kind of project teams composed of the participants according to their personality types. The experiment showed that the third kind of project teams coped with tasks much better than other groups.

articleTitle: Blended Learning as a form of Transition from Traditional Learning to Digital Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The introduction of massive open online courses (MOOCs) in the educational process is a natural response of universities to modern development trends. The article provides a brief analysis of the implementation of MOOCs in Russia and in the world. The most popular online courses that can be used in the learning process at any university are actively developing at the St. Petersburg Polytechnic University. The experience of the organization of blended learning at the Institute of Industrial Management, Economics and Trade of the St. Petersburg Polytechnic University using the developed and implemented mass open online courses is described in detail. The results of learning achievement changes, forms of communication and problems encountered in the implementation of the MOOCs are given. Directions of decision of arising up problems are offered. The next step in the development of education is the transition to digital learning with use of the developed MOOCs in SPbSPU as a form of training employees of various companies.

articleTitle: Vibration and Noise Analysis of a Coaxial Magnetic Gear
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the present work are estimated vibration and noise spectrums of a coaxial magnetic gear under no-load operational conditions. The developed approach is used to incorporate three different types of vibration analyzes: random vibration, response spectrum and harmonic response analyzes, based on modal analysis results. Finite element method modeling is implemented by Ansys-Workbench software. Results are obtained and analyzed for mechanical deformation, local accelerations and influence of modal shapes frequencies on vibration spectra during operational modes of a coaxial magnetic gear. Simulations in different rotational speeds and kinematic schemes are performed and results for the vibration and noise spectrums are presented.

articleTitle: Torque and Power Density of Coaxial Magnetic Gears
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the present work, the recent positive trend in torque and power density of the coaxial magnetic gears is discussed. Timeline of magnetic gears development according to design topology and magnetic materials improvements is presented. Five generations of magnetic gears are recognized according to the torque density limitations. Analysis of possible design and material improvement opportunities is made. Main approach for torque and power density improvement is the maximization of the air-gap surface in magnetic gear volume. For coaxial magnetic gears this is possible by implementation of conical and multistage rotor designs. Theoretical limitations in case of conical and multistage rotors usage are considered.

articleTitle: New Approach at Mechanical Engraving of Details with Large Sizes
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this work a new approach for the mechanical engraving of details with large sizes is proposed. The main stages of the work at engraving of details with large sizes have been defined. The test of engraving of detail with large sizes has been done. The main advantages and disadvantages of the proposed approach are determined.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Selection of the Weighting Matrices Q and R in Linear Quadratic Regulator
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: A method for determining the weighting matrices Q and R in the linear stationary system control by a linear quadratic regulator is proposed. By minimizing the error, the coefficients in the weighting matrices Q and R are optimized. The proposed method allows the setting of even unknown systems, and knowing the behavior of the system it can be used to accurately adjust the operation of a particular channel.

articleTitle: Continuous Constrained Bending with active friction forces based on double Conform process
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this work was investigated the possibility of realization of severe plastic deformation with active friction forces through a continuous constrained bending based on the ECAP Conform process. The process of two-stage continuous constrained bending was simulated in grooved rolls for long size deformable copper alloy rods. A virtual decision has been proposed for a new continuous bending scheme with two zones of severe plastic deformation performed by two grooved rolls (feeding and output) and a bending channel with a roller between them. The accumulated degree and the non-uniformity of the effective strains in the deformed work-piece during the different stages of the process realization were analysed. A relationship between the diameter of continuous bending (the diameter of the bending channel with a roller) and the degree of accumulated effective strains was established.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Integrating E-Learning and Open Educational Resources into Classroom
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this paper are presented the results from research in the field of use of informational resources in several schools from three countries. The main paper goals are to present the technology of developed inquiry Open Educational Resources (OERs) describe analysis of the received results. With the use of OER the educational system undergoes a qualitative change as a result of changes in the way the actual content and teaching methods. Conclusions are listed.

articleTitle: Conductive Silver Layers on Anodic Aluminum Oxide
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This study demonstrates the possibility of silver layer fabrication on nanoporous anodic aluminum oxide (AAO) by electroless deposition with tin (II) ions preactivating of the surface. Scanning electron microscopy and energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy were used to observe the layer morphology and the silver penetration into AAO respectively. The kinetics of the chemical deposition on the nanoporous surface and the influence of the silver thickness on the sheet resistance of obtained layers were established.

articleTitle: Study of PWM Solar Charge Controller Operation Modes in Autonomous DC System
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this paper is presented a test bench for laboratory exercises in the field of specialized power supplies: a PWM solar charge controller. It is composed of the following main blocks: a PV panel (which is simulated by a controllable DC power source), a PWM solar controller, a lead-acid battery and a DC load. The developed laboratory test bench can be used for simulating various conditions of the stand-alone PV system: excess of PV power, shortage of PVpower and a low battery conditions. By using this test bench the students can learn the main principles of autonomous PVsystems operation, the operation of the PV charge controller itself and the differences between PWM and MPPT charge controllers for solar systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of Higher Harmonics During Reactive Power Compensation by a Capacitor Bank
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper presents experimental and numerical study of higher harmonics in a low voltage grid with a compensating capacitor bank with discrete action. The switching of the capacitor bank leads to generation of higher harmonics, which influence on the rest of the devices in the grid. On the other hand, when a capacitor bank operates in a grid with higher harmonics, the current through the capacitor bank increases. The experiments, related to this analysis, have been conducted by means of a laboratory capacitor bank. The theoretical part of the study has been realized with the help of computer models, developed in MATLAB/Simulink. The processes in the grid have been analyzed when the capacitor bank operates with an inductive reactor in the circuit of the capacitors. A comparison has been drawn between the transient processes of both the current and the voltage when the capacitor bank is switched on by means of a contactor with or without damping resistance.

articleTitle: Statistical Characterization of Electric Power Production and Importation: Case Study of Benin Electricity Community (CEB)
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The regularity between electricity supply and demand brings electricity companies to develop efficient and reliable models based on deterministic or stochastic approaches. To satisfy the demand of both Togolese and Beninese Republics in the interconnected area apart from its own production of Nangbeto hydropower plant, Benin Electricity Company imports electricity from Volta River Authority in Ghana, Transmission Company of Nigeria in Nigeria, and Ivoirian Electricity Company in Ivory Coast. The scope of this paper is to propose a statistical approach using probability density functions to characterize the electricity generation of Nangbeto hydropower plant and electricity importation from Volta River Authority / Ivoirian Electricity Company Transmission Company of Nigeria. The aim is to predict the probability of electrical energy available at each generation and importation source at a given time. By using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov goodness of fit test and some statistical performance indicators, it is demonstrated that Skewnormal distribution provides a better fitting of the production data and importation from VRA/CIE. However, the Weibull distribution fits well the importations from TCN.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Induction Heating with Heat Transfer of Cylindrical Body for Pressing Treatment
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The present paper considers a mathematical model of the process of induction heating of cylindrical pieces with heat transfer. A mathematical model has been developed that considers heat exchange through convection between the parts and the environment. In this way, more accurate results are obtained compared to other methods for modeling induction heating heat transfer. Another advantage of the presented method is the relatively small requirements for the computing power of computers, which allows its application for the purposes of training in power electronics. To verify the results obtained from a mathematical model we compare these results with the induction heated detail from the machine RITO-630/1-A-L type with a SMK UB 2F2 power source.

articleTitle: The Impact of Digitalization on the Measurement of value in the production and operation of industrial products
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: One of the important questions in the development of economics and technology in general is how does digitalization affect value, in terms of value change in the manufacturing sector or in the exploitation of industrial products. The measurement of value is done by evaluating a set of activities that are combined in a specific way across time and space. Activity control also requires appropriate organization. Organizational behavior is a key determinant of value-adding in such companies. Factors that determine value are: stimulating and implementing an appropriate policy that provides competitive advantage and high efficiency. In essence, this means well-established network linear and functional connections at all organizational levels and all units in measuring value. The purpose of this article is to investigate the process of managing / the impact of digitalisation on changes in value in production, and in particular in industrial products, as a transition to cyber systems.

articleTitle: Microprocessor System for Studying the Parameters of Dual-collector Bipolar Magnetic Transistor
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Semiconductor silicon sensors have become widespread in practice. Various types of magnetic field sensors are known, such as Hall elements, magnetoresistive, magnetic field diode, magnetotransistors, magneto-thyristor, magnetosensitive integrated circuits and more. However, the challenge remains of exploring their parameters and exploring their capabilities and fields of application. This paper proposes the development of an electronic system based on the ATmega128 microcontroller to study the parameters of magnetotransistors. Measurements were made and the results were compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Marketing Research as a Main Factor in the Strategic Management of Bio-Based Industries in Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the study it was discussed how the market research today impacts on strategic decision making process in modern business, and looks at the critical role of a market research to achieve bio-based business success. The survey was executed on the basis of an analysis of the development of the marketing research market. The trends of this market were explored through secondary official statistics. This study shows that in the context of the digital economy the marketing research should be recognized as a main factor in the formulation of the strategy of the bio-based companies in Bulgaria.

articleTitle: Key Performance Indicators the providers of logistic services: experience of selected companies
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: this paper describes the term logistics service provider and their types. Authors shown the three short case studies that are oriented to KPI in practice. One of them is oriented to KPI for customer satisfaction measurement (DHL Express CZ). The other one is oriented to KPI in warehouse during the changes the processes in company. The third one is oriented to the key factors of company competitiveness related to customer service efficiency. The main aim of paper is the presentation of key performance indicator in the field of logistics service providing from the practical point of view.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Motion Management by Interaction between Mobile Robot and Human
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In some cases of mobile robot motion control, the human send to the robot simple voice commands only as the separated words such as “forward”, “backward”, “turn” and etc. In other cases for mobile robot motion management, the human interaction with mobile robot is similar to a real conversation between them using more complicated voice commands as long phrases or sentences. Therefore, in this article is proposed an algorithm of mobile robot motion management, based on voice recognition containing phrases and sentences in cases of human interaction with mobile robot using artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Studying entrepreneurial attitudes of students - case study of TU-Varna
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The purpose of this publication is to present the results of an empirical study of the attitudes and intentions of students from TU-Varna for the realization of entrepreneurial activity. In this connection, the opinion of the target group (a profile of the students in terms of their entrepreneurial attitudes) has been studied and concrete measures have been proposed to encourage entrepreneurial initiatives among young people. On the basis of the research, the following results were achieved: the respondents opinion was studied, the profile of the students was identified, opportunities for raising the students' attitudes, knowledge, skills and competences were identified to start up their own business and/or implement an entrepreneurial idea.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Transient Processes During Switching in a Medium Voltage Vacuum Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of the results from experimental studies of the transient processes during commutation of an electric circuit by means of a medium voltage vacuum circuit breaker for the following two cases: vacuum and air insulation environment at natural atmospheric pressure. The analyses have been conducted with the help of a specially developed experimental setup. Results about both cases of commutation have been obtained for predominantly active and predominantly inductive loads. Comparison of the obtained experimental results has been made.

articleTitle: Application of Innovations in SMEs from Wine Industry in Bulgaria: the Case of Plovdiv Region
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The economic development of a country, a region or an economic sector is associated with the introduction of innovation. The sector of wine production is traditional for the Bulgarian economy and thus the innovation activity in the sector can contribute to the overall development of the economic processes. The current paper presents the results of a pilot study. Through it we tested the questionnaire, which we are going to use in the final field work. Furthermore, it provides some preliminary results on what innovations have been applied in SMEs from wine industry, located in Plovdiv region. Thus, the questionnaire was sent to a selection of representatives of the sector. The results indicate that this format of the questions is easy to be understood and doesn't require much times to be filled. It also showed us that the wine producers already apply most of the suggested innovation or would apply them.

articleTitle: Metal Oxides Influence on the Morphology and Structure of the Polychloroprene Adhesive Composition
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The aim of our study is to explore the effects of the vulcanizing agents ZnO and MgO, the interaction occurring between the rubber and other ingredients within the composition, on the properties of the obtained adhesives. Morphological study of the over molecular structure formation are carried out, and a comparison is made with physico-mechanical tests of seven adhesive compositions in order to explain the adhesive joint formation. By means of morphological investigation it was found that ZnO is dispersed in the rubber as separate aggregates, and it is referred to as a mechanical impurity which not affects the polymer properties, whereas MgO is involved in associates with rubber macromolecules. Thus, MgO equally participates with rubber in the deformation processes of the composition, thereby achieving desirable optimal properties. It was determined the resin in an optimal defined amount and optimal mixing regimes to obtain adhesives with the best mechanical properties.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Electroless Metallization of Carbon Nanotubes and Aluminium Sintering Components
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper concerns the study of ultrasonic electroless metallization of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) and aluminium sintering components as a reinforcing phase for the production of aluminium metal matrix composites. The efficiency of the developed alkaline solution based on two metal salts in regard to depositing nickel-phosphorus, nickel-copper and nickel-tin coating on non-metalic (CNTs) and metallic dispersive phase was confirmed. The presence of two metal salts in the chemical solution improves the stability of the process of electroless metallization and makes possible to perform it at a room temperature under the conditions of ultrasonic bath treatment.

articleTitle: An Approach for Integrating Joomla with LDAP
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Joomla is a free and open-source content management system (CMS) for publishing web content. It is the second most widely used CMS in the world. LDAP is an open standard which is commonly used to provide a central place for storing users and users' data. In this article we propose approach for integrating Joomla, with OpenLDAP, based on usage of the Joomla LDAP Authentication plugin and JMapMyLDAP extension.

articleTitle: Representation with Index Matrices of Single Ended Primary Inductor Converter Functioning
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper aims to represent with index matrices electronic circuit functioning. A specific example (SEPIC) illustrates the proposed methodology. The last one provides automated modelign of electronic devices containing two-terminal components. Index matrices with real number elements are used in voltage and amperage calculations in order operations with sparse usual matrixes to be avoided. In addition, the given approach is also applicable in electronics education, particulary - in fundamental training.

articleTitle: Challenges to HR Specialists in High-Tech Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The dynamic development of technology in today's digital world is leading to changes in business models, which predetermines a radical change in the role of HR professionals. The report outlines the trends in HRM work and the challenges facing HR professionals. On the basis of their own research, the authors show the evaluation of the competences of the specialists in human resources management in the high-tech enterprises.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Potential for Development of the Bio-Economy in Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The bioeconomy covers "the production of renewable biological resources and the conversion of those resources and waste streams into value-added products, such as food, feed, bio-based products and bioenergy" [1]. The concepts of the bioeconomy and the circular economy ultimately pursue different main goals: While the circular economy focuses only on "maintaining the value of products, materials and resources in the economy for as long as possible," many elements of the bioeconomy go beyond that goal. The bioeconomy and the circular economy share some of the goals: a more sustainable and resource-efficient and low-carbon world. In Bulgaria there is still a limited understanding of the added value of eco-innovation, the effects of defragmentation of the value chain, the consequences of the limited application of environmental investments, as well as the lack of appropriate financial instruments stimulating technological progress [2]. This report has been developed in the framework of the Bulgarian scientific program that supports research in the field of bioeconomy and sustainable development. This analysis was prepared as a result of a survey conducted within the project by interviewing 285 organic producers from all regions of Bulgaria. The purpose of the study is to analyze the situation in Bulgaria for the development of the organic sector in terms of production capacity, potential for growth of the organic production sector, to study the conditions, difficulties and prospects for the development of exports of organic products. The analysis will serve to evaluate the opportunities for regional bioeconomy development and the diversification of the agricultural sector.

articleTitle: Transformation of Consumer's Digital Shadow in a Smart City
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Transformation of cities to smart cities becomes possible only with full digitalization of all processes of interaction between the objects included in it. To improve communication between them, in which the consumer stands in the center, it is necessary to study him and his needs through characteristics. The process of studying these characteristics of a digital consumer portrait is the process of forming a consumer's digital shadow.

articleTitle: Cutting performance of experimental alumina-based ceramic cutting tools in turning of C45, 42Cr4 and 100Cr6 steels
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper explores the performance of alumina- based ceramic cutting tools, rated with the tool life, surface roughness and cutting power used as evaluation parameters when turning C45, 42Cr4 and 100Cr6 steels. Adequate theoretical-experimental models have been built. The performance between mixed alumina ceramic tools and zirconia toughened alumina ceramic tools is compared and appropriate combinations of processed and tool material are recommended. It was found that in the whole study ranges of cutting speed and feed for all machined materials, the cutting tools of mixed ceramic show better performance evaluated with the surface roughness parameter. In the area of high cutting speeds and large feeds, cutting tools of mixed ceramic show better tool life and cutting power.

articleTitle: Model-based Optimization of a Boost DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper presents model-based optimization of a dc-dc boost converter. Initially, based on a reputable mathematical model created by the authors, was conducted a study to determine the influence the tolerance of filter elements of the converter to its output voltage. The purpose is to evaluate the type of transient process data and the dynamics of the power circuit. Then, model based optimization was developed along the reference curve of the converter output. New values are obtained which are used again to make tolerance analysis. As a result, an aperiodical process for the settling of the output voltage is obtained, invariant from the tolerance of circuit elements. In addition, the dynamics of the converter are similar, thus making use of control synthesis is easier. This ensures that the output of the power electronic converter is guaranteed.

articleTitle: PSpice Investigation of Harmonic Analysis of a Rectangular Pulse
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this paper is presented an application of PSpice simulation in the teaching process, concerning discipline “Circuits and signals”. Harmonic analysis of a rectangular periodic signal has been done both with the help of analytical transformations and on the basis of computer simulations. The main goal is to increase students' knowledge in their training about the nature of the processes, by means of modern, advanced and interesting methods. For this purpose, rectangular periodic signal is investigated and its harmonic or spectral analysis is performed. The periodic signal in Fourier series is presented as a system of trigonometric functions with multiple arguments. The spectral analysis is analytically defined and the simulation model in PSpice environment is composed. The analytical results are compared with those obtained from computer simulation.

articleTitle: Communication Networks and Regional Entities
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The author explores relation between regional entities and communication networks that are formed across regions. In this research the author ties to analyze the role of communication networks for regional development. The object of this research is regional entities. The author uses for his analysis system and territorial approach.

articleTitle: Common Methodology for Effectively Forecasting the Subscriber’s Daily Natural Gas Consumption
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Cutting costs and improving operational efficiency is something that energy and utility companies are continually working towards. It's a constant battle, and the work is never complete. Energy and utility companies must focus on longer-term goals to ensure appropriate hedging and maximize profitability, but the high-resolution accuracy provided by load forecasting limits the amount of money wasted in the short-term. This requires insight into expected seasonal weather patterns and accurate demand planning and any immediate changes in the approaching weather. This study proposes a common methodology for effectively forecasting daily consumption through the statistical processing of input data, and stochastic optimization methods are applied. The input data are certain indicators of the factors influencing the consumption process. These indicators are sampled in the stochastic process.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Networks With Java Implementation
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: We are at the verge of AI powered tools to have the knowhow of the human brain. Imagine the benefits; boost of performance, time saving on menial tasks and improved service delivery. Artificial neural networks and artificial intelligence networks model based on structure and functions of human biological neural networks are gearing up to have a huge impact on business processes everywhere. As a matter of fact a lot of companies nowadays are already using similar technics of neural networking technology and are creating frameworks for their implementation. For example Microsoft has deep neural network to classify malware and has recently previewed Project Brainwave, a hardware architecture that makes real-time AI calculations. This project is being tested for providing solutions for automated optical inspection system. The system will scan products on the assembly line for defects with lighting speed. Meanwhile, IBM has released a beta of its Neural Network Modeler in Watson Studio that lets developers use a visual approach to designing deep learning architectures for image, text and audio data. In fewer words this is the game changer of business processes in this new era of Artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Wind Electric Machine Without Stators
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This article presents the authors' approach for advancements the cross axis wind electric machines: a combination of improvements of the conventional wind rotors and of their coupling to the electricity generators. The main features and advantages of the invented Wind Electric Machine Without Stators are described.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Turning Process with Experimental Alumina-Based Ceramic Cutting Tools Using a Generalized Utility Function
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Optimum cutting conditions for turning are defined in the literature for a particular type of cutting tool and a particular processed material. The paper attempts to determine the optimum cutting conditions for turning of C45, 42Cr4 and 100Cr6 steels with experimental alumina-based ceramic cutting tools designed at the Technical University of Gabrovo. Multi-purpose optimization based on the generalized utility function and the scanning method has been applied. Generalized utility function models have been created depending on the cutting speed and the feed in turning. The optimal cutting conditions in turning of C45, 42Cr4 and 100Cr6 steels with experimental cutting tools of zirconia toughened and mixed alumina ceramics at which the generalized utility function has a maximum, have been determined. They ensure the best combination between tool lifetime, surface roughness and cutting power.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Wagons Sorting Process for Needs of Real-Time Marshalling Yard Management System
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Nowadays many methods for solving of marshalling yard problem exist. Most of them are not appropriate for use in software for real-time marshalling yard management systems. Optimization method proposed in this paper considers the incoming train composition as vector-row, wherein the vector elements are the different directions. All incoming trains represented in this way form the input matrix. The resulting input matrix transformed into the resulting output matrix arranged in the outgoing directions, which can be a different number of rows from the input. The shortest path method by forming maximum groups used for optimization. The proposed method is suitable for use in real-time marshalling yard management systems..

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Some Factors on the Electric and Thermal Field of a Power Distribution Block
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Numerical analyses considering the influence of the contact resistance and the type of material of the conductive elements in a closed low voltage distribution block are carried out for the electric and thermal field of the block. A 3D model of the block in the software product COMSOL has been used to conduct the analyses. Results, related to the distribution of the electric and thermal field at increased contact resistance and when using conductive elements made of copper or aluminum have been got.

articleTitle: Challenges in the Power Supply for the Needs of Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The energy infrastructure associated with increasing the capacity of the transmission and distribution networks is very complex in view of exploring and realizing its stages in the upgrading. It is important to analyze and anticipate the dynamics in the long-term development of consumers as well as the amount of investment (CAPEX) and operational (OPEX) costs required in this context.

articleTitle: Gender-Comparative Study the Behavioral Factors Impact on Entrepreneurship Intentions of Business Students
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Entrepreneurial activities are a leading force of contemporary society. Researchers have long explored the gender differences by starting new businesses. The primary purpose of this research is to examine the gender peculiarities of behavioral drivers' impact on intentions of students in business studies for entrepreneurship. The research is founder on the Theory of Planned Behavior. It argues, the leading factors that influence the intention of given behavior are attitudes to the beahvior, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control. The study comprises students from business studies at the universities in Poland, Bulgaria and Ukraine. e.

articleTitle: Electric Field Modeling in Case of Human Presence in the Vicinity of Power Line
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper presents results of study of electric field distribution in the vicinity of a power line in the presence of a human body. The field is investigated by numerical experiments based on 3D numerical modeling using a finite element method. A special feature of the study is the application of a new approach in the modeling based on additional, more precise secondary FEM analysis in a small domain close to the human, when the human body is modeled in more detail and is able to move its limbs and takes a different position. In the secondary analysis, for boundary conditions of a new, small, close to the human body region, are used the field values that have been obtained from the analysis of the whole domain with the simplified human figure.

articleTitle: 3D Coupled Electromagnetic-Thermal-Fluid Analysis of a Low Voltage Switchboard
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The aim of this paper is a comparative analysis of 3D computer models of a low voltage switchboard. The models are developed in the program COMSOL. Models for the following types of problems have been developed: the coupled electromagnetic-thermal-fluid problem with taking into account the electromagnetic losses in the switchboard, the thermodynamic processes in the switchboard, the heat exchange by radiation and convection from the outer surface of the switchboard to the environment, as well as the distribution of the thermal flow along the supply cables; the coupled electric-thermal-fluid problem, without taking into account the eddy currents; the coupled electric-thermal problem without taking into account the eddy currents and the thermodynamic processes in the switchboard. Comparison between the obtained numerical results has been made.

articleTitle: Short-Circuit Currents Modeling for a Wind Farm Connected in Parallel to the Electric Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This work presents the results from computer modeling of the short-circuit currents in a wind farm, connected to an electric grid of high capacity. The farm consists of eight equivalent SCIG-type wind generators, connected by a step-up substation 0.69/21/115kV to the electric power grid. The short-circuit currents are studied with computer model, which is synthesized in MatLab/Simulink. Results have been obtained for the transient current processes in case of three-phase, double-phase short-circuit and earth fault both with working and cut off generators. The influence of the moment in which a short circuit occurs on the short-circuit current peak has been studied. Results both about the peak and the steady state short-circuit currents in dependence on the location of occurrence and the type of short circuit have also been obtained.

articleTitle: Gender-Comparative Study the Environmental Factors Impact on Entrepreneurial Intentions of Students from Business Studies
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Creation of new business is a significant factor that impels the societal progress. Sociologists are already sufficiently aware of the gender gap in starting a business and succeeding by examining gender models in the self-employment market. The primary research aim is to examine the gender aspects of impact of indirect factors on intentions for entrepreneurship of business students. It is founded on the Theory of Planned Behavior. The study comprises students from business studies at the universities in Poland, Bulgaria and Ukraine.

articleTitle: Laboratory System For Monitoring And Forecasting The Parameters Of Sea Waves
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Researchers' training in renewable energy is becoming more and more relevant. The present report describes the development of the Burgas Free University laboratory base for exploring various aspects of renewable energy and especially the possibilities of forecasting the parameters of the sea waves.

articleTitle: All Digital PLL for Wireless Power Transmit
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The effort to develop an adaptive functional control system for power wireless transmit has led to building up many principal schemes, which have different complexity and functional possibility [8], [10]. This paper proposes a method for frequency adjustment to provide maximum transmit power. The development of a digital control system is based on programmable logical device Xilinx Cool Runner xc2c256. Energy is transmitted to multiple receivers, one of which is used for feedback. The other modules are for general supply.

articleTitle: Neural Networks for Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper presents Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDPS) and their classification emphasizing on the use of neural networks in IDS. Contemporary IDS usually include both signature verification and anomaly detection approaches realized by rule-based expert system and statistical module correspondingly. Neural networks may be used mainly as additional module to the statistical module to better recognize the user behavior. User behavior may be represented as frequency pattern of users command history. The paper presents an example of user profile vector for Unix-based platforms.

articleTitle: Obtaining of Nanocomposite Material with Metal Matrix and Carbide Reinforcing Particles by Electromagnetic Stirring
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: There are several factors involved in making metal matrix composite materials that require considerable attention. These include the difficulty of achieving a uniform particle distribution, wetting ability between the two basic substances, the porosity of the cast composite materials and the chemical reactions between the reinforcing particles and the matrix alloy. In order to achieve the optimum properties of the composite material, the distribution of the reinforcing material in the metal matrix must be uniform, and the wettability or bonding between these substances must be optimized. One method of homogenizing the melt is by electromagnetic stirring. The purpose of the present work is to provide an inverter with the necessary characteristics to obtain a composite material with a metal matrix and carbide reinforcing nano-particles.

articleTitle: Comparative Post-Optimal Analysis to Effectively Forecasting the Subscriber's Daily Natural Gas Consumption
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Although there are developments to predict energy consumption, the topic has not been exhausted and remains relevant. It should also be noted that each author uses the power of models differently to interpret inputs and outputs and their effects on the consumption process. Cutting costs and improving operational efficiency is something that energy and utility companies are continually working towards. It's a constant battle, and the work is never complete. This study offers a comparative post-optimal analysis to effectively predict daily consumption through statistical processing of input data and methods of stochastic optimization are applied. Input data are defined indicators of factors affecting the consumption process. These indicators are sampled in the stochastic process.

articleTitle: A Discrete Model of Multi-Agent Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The article discussed a discreet model of computer security based on threat vulnerability theory. The model examined the effect of the action of numerous threats on the integrated IDS, comprised of various antiviral agents.On the basis of this postulate there are derived some analytical dependencies, showing the impact of diversity of used antivirus agents on the security improvement of the system. Using obtained formulae an example case is solved which confirms the reasoning. There are proposed a variety of future tasks and works in the field of system security improvement and optimization.

articleTitle: Perspectives of Video Games Market Development as a Part of Creative Business
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Video games are a sub-sector within the Creative Business, which has achieved during the recent years one of the impressive development within the European Union. This paper is dedicated to examine the reasons behind this rapid development as well as to explore the different possibilities to accelerate this development. Related economy sectors and other peripheral activities also could benefits in a larger degree from this rapid development in case that they are properly identified and included into common European supportive policy. In the present paper we reveal the trends of development of video game market as a part of Creative Business and provide some recommendations for the future policy, dedicated to the enhance one of the fastest growing sectors of the modern economy.

articleTitle: Obtaining of Activated Carbon using Chemical Activation with KOH
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The objective of this paper is producing an active carbon based on wasted biomass, including chemical activation with KOH. Activation with KOH of carbonaceous materials is considered to be an extremely promising method of producing "HighTech" activated carbon. The texture parameters of the obtained activated carbon are determined by low-temperature nitrogen adsorption. It was found that they are with well expressed adsorption-desorption characteristics. The obtained samples were determined also by pH and IEP. As a result of the experimental studies, obtaining of a material with high surface area was produced, which can be used as absorbents in liquid and gas phases, catalysts, for electrochemical, biochemical and other specific applications.

articleTitle: Development and Experimentation of Technology for Production of Aluminum Alloy Foams using CaCO3
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the work was studied the possibility of production of foam based on aluminum alloy and calcium carbonate. Foaming is carried out by direct addition of the foaming agent in the molten metal by high-speed stirring. As a result, a foamed metal with closed unevenly distributed pores is obtained which is electrically conductive and has a density of 0.47 g / cm3 (floats in water).

articleTitle: Training System for Studing Computer Clusters
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper presents construction of a computer cluster system for learning purposes. Both disused PCs and new generation Raspberry Pi 3 single-chip microcomputers are used. The aim is to study the performance, fault tolerance and energy efficiency parameters. The possibility of realizing and exploring a heterogeneous system from both clusters as well as its application for solving real practical tasks is considered.

articleTitle: Information Security of PHP Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Exclusive flexibility in developing dynamic web applications, which PHP offers, makes it one of the most common Web programming languages today. The popularity of the language increases the number of web applications written in PHP and the questions with the security issues, which these applications arise. In this article we present strategies and best practices for developing secure code with PHP. We make brief overview of the main types of attacks, classified by CWE, which may affect the PHP applications and best practice how to avoid them.

articleTitle: Digitalization in Information Activities Related to Systems for Managing Discrete Production Processes
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The future belongs to technical development supported fundamentally new industrial technologies, e-government, computer-integrated manufacturing activities and therefore the pursuit of minimizing or replacing human labor in manufacturing and other activities through AI. The opportunities for continuous improvement of production methods, as well as all the things that are expected to support this process, suggest what could improve modern production. Of course, if we have better systems for information exchange as well as innovative methods for miniaturization of objects in computer technology, this could change the production trends worldwide. The most probable trend for the development of production in the coming years is to consider it in summary using the acquired knowledge and different ways of creating products, as well as providing connections to external suppliers. This report examines the digitalization of data activities associated with ACS of discrete production processes and therefore the application of AI.

articleTitle: Influential Factors on the Process of Technological Development through Innovative and Planned Aging
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Technological development influences various factors, both on the products and on the processes throughout their life cycle. This leads to rapid innovation aging of products and processes and creates a sort of attitude for manufacturers to look for ways and means to eliminate the harmful effects of their impact. This speed also coincides with the aging plan of the companies, or the fact that the industrial products are rapidly deteriorating and the purchase of new ones is becoming more and more rapid. The tendency to search for solutions to eliminate their rapid innovation aging has already formed a new alternative concept for innovation development. It also puts new requirements both on the consumer nature of innovative products and on the methods, approaches and ways of their production and consumption. This new approach, quickly adopted by manufacturers, is already showing its advantages in the practice of many industrial companies. The purpose of this report is to determine the main directions of its alternative and development on the basis of an analytical study of this process. Essentially, this means controlling the shortening of product lifecycles, reducing their resource use and controlling the resource of reliability.

articleTitle: Globalization Influence on Information and Communication Systems in Regions
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The regions are the territory where regional development is realized. Globalization as modern processes reflects directly on regions and local entities. The author aims to analyze the influence of globalization processes on information and computer systems in regions. The structure of this paper consists two main parts - information and computer systems and social networks as special relations between people in different regional entities.

articleTitle: Method and Algorithm for Calibration Accuracy Evaluation of Uncooled Thermo-Visual Infrared Sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Thermo-visual infrared sensors calibration is directly related with precision of objects temperature measurements, true reproduction and real view of thermal images. The wide spread uncooled thermo-visual infrared sensors need precise temperature calibration. There are a lot of methods and algorithms for this calibration, but more often the estimation of their accuracy are made subjectively. Therefore, the goal of this article is to propose and realized the appropriate method and corresponding algorithm for objective estimation of results from uncooled thermo-visual sensors temperature calibration.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Energy Parameters of Multiple EVs
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the current paper an estimation of energy parameters in electric vehicles is presented. Multiple electric vehicles are examined with their characteristics. The main purposes of this article is to create comparatively simpler mathematical model for estimation of energy flow during acceleration and braking. For this reason an urban and suburban dynamometer cycles are used.

articleTitle: Evaluating Solar Energy Harvesting using Artificial Neural Networks: A Case study in Togo
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The work sought to develop a model for the evaluation of solar energy harvesting potentials in Togo using an approach based on artificial neural networks (ANNs) in order to predict the daily irradiation for some areas under climatic conditions. Two types of ANN architecture were evaluated the radial basic function (RBF) and multi-layer perceptron (MLP). The data were collected in 28 cities, and data from of 8 cities were used for the training stage in order to come with the suitable model for the other cities. The results indicated that the ANN-MLP model 8 has provided the best performance and its accuracy was tested. Furthermore, the solar generation potential was evaluated. The sites in the study have exhibited a high potential for solar energy generation.

articleTitle: Model of Data Bases of Veterinary Medical Journal of Apiary
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the work is proposed a model of structure for an automated database for a veterinary medical journal of an apiary. The structure of separate tables and their distribution are considered. Its show the relations between different tables and search capabilities are discussed.

articleTitle: Creativity enhancement method for STEM education
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Personal types of students were determined in accordance with the Myers-Briggs typology. It is established that the dominant types of students - prospective teachers of Maths - basically correspond to the dominant types of students studying a science, mathematics, engineering and technology. The effectiveness of the heuristic method largely depends on the selection of students for the project team and the distribution of roles within the team in accordance with the personality type of students. Creativity enhancement method united the Myers-Briggs typology and heuristic methods are developed.

articleTitle: Evolution of the Advancements in Cross Axis Wind Electric Machines
publicationTitle: 2019 II International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This article presents a kind of apologetics for cross-flow wind machines. At the beginning, general knowledge and initial stages of development for S-type rotors are described. The historical review continues with the stage of reduced interest, followed by the stage of enhanced interest after the oil crisis of 70-ies. The main advancements and advantages are conveyed. Historical evolution of cross-flow runners is also addressed. A brief look on the evolution of coaxial wind and electrical rotors is provided as an introduction to the authors' approach for advancements: a combination of improvements of the conventional wind rotors and of their coupling to the electricity generators. The invented Wind Electric Machine Without Stators is quoted. The development of competitive vertical axis wind machines is suggested as an important public task, which has to change the agenda of the wind industry.
